sentences.en: This building is a capsule hotel lodging men and women.
sentences.zh: 这栋建筑是一家胶囊旅馆，男女都有。

sentences.en: Take this capsule within thirty minutes of each meal.
sentences.zh: 饭后三十分钟内服用此胶囊。

sentences.en: The Orion capsule may one day carry human beings to Mars.
sentences.zh: 奥赖恩太空舱将来可能载人前往火星。

senses.zh: 胶囊；[植] 蒴果；太空舱；小容器
